Protect the skittish [[Fadden Hathorn]] as he gathers [[Devourer Egg|devourer eggs]] from a nearby cave to ensure [[Duke Gaban]] gets his morning omelet.

==Quest Information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Escort Fadden Hathorn into the Devourer {{sic|devourer}} cave and keep him safe while he gathers eggs.
* Escort Fadden Hathorn back to Duke Gaban.
* Return to Duke Gaban for your reward.

===Reward===
* 150 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* 2 [[Devourer Egg]]s

===Environmental changes===
* Upon completing this quest, Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn will no longer spawn in [[Lakeside County]]. They can both be seen again post-[[Searing]], Fadden in [[Sardelac Sanitarium]] and Duke Gaban in the [[Bonus Mission Pack]].
* Upon completing this quest, the [[Devourer Nest]]s will no longer be interactive.

==Walkthrough==
Exit [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]], cross the river to the south, and head slightly uphill to locate Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn (hold Alt if you have trouble spotting them). Accept the quest and lead Fadden into the cave.

Fadden will flee from any living [[devourer]], even though most are not hostile. To keep him moving, you must systematically clear the cave. The eight level 1 [[Carrion Devourer|Carrion]] and [[Lash Devourer]]s inside shouldn't pose much of a threat, especially if you pull them one by one.

One level 0 [[Diseased Devourer]] will unburrow at the second nest and attack you, and two more will strike at the third. This can trigger nearby devourers to attack as well. Focus down the level 0 ambushers first, as they drop after one or two basic attacks, which quickly brings down the incoming damage.

Once Fadden gathers all three eggs, escort him back to the Duke. Two Lash Devourers will spawn near the cave entrance while you are inside. If you haven't already, clear them out so Fadden can safely exit and you can claim your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Duke Gaban
:''"You there! You look like a sturdy <Character profession>. I've tasked my man Fadden here with retrieving devourer eggs for me from the cave over yonder. However, he appears unmanned by the devourers, afraid of being eaten or some rot like that. I need a brave soul to keep the devourers away from Fadden while he does the job for which he has been paid.''

:''"What say you to that?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll protect Fadden.
| decline = Why don't you do it yourself?
| ask = Get back in that cave and make sure Fadden gathers all of the eggs that he can.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
If you go away from the cave:
:'''Fadden Hathorn:''' ''"Hello! The devourer eggs are back in the cave. I'll head back there and wait for you."''

Repeated for each [[Devourer Nest|nest]]:
:'''Fadden Hathorn:''' ''"Look, there's an egg!"''
:'''Fadden Hathorn:''' ''"This will only take a moment. Wait for me, will you?"''
:'''Fadden Hathorn:''' ''"Got it! Let's keep moving."''

When Fadden collects all 3 eggs:
:'''Fadden Hathorn:''' ''"Thank you ever so much for your assistance. Let's get back to the duke."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Duke Gaban
:''"Well done. I'll give you a couple eggs for your trouble. I'm not usually so generous, but I happen to be in a jovial mood at the moment."''

== Notes ==
* Upon completing the quest, Duke Gaban will give you two devourer eggs. One can be used in the quest [[The Worm Problem]] and the other in [[The Rogue's Replacement]]. You can also get eggs by giving [[Brownlow]] five [[Skale Fin (pre-Searing)|skale fins]] or trading with another player.
* Two [[Hidden Stash]]es also [[spawn]] in the cave. On rare occasions, this might block Fadden's path. To get him to move, try pulling some foes nearby, which should cause him to flee. If that does not work, you will have to rezone and try again.

{{bug|When you attack a devourer that is trapped behind a rock or egg, your attacks can be obstructed. Reposition yourself so that you can attack from a different angle (or bring skills that can do damage without a line-of-sight). }}
